bullets.text: Autonomous Container Transport Trial - **Port of Tyne** advances towards autonomous operations with successful self-driving vehicle deployment.
Belden Acquires RUCKUS Networks - **Belden** strengthens its networking solutions portfolio with a $1.85 billion acquisition of **RUCKUS**.
EE's AI Triple-Lock Protection - **EE** enhances its Scam Guard service with advanced AI features to combat rising scam threats.
VMO2's Renewable Energy Initiative - **Virgin Media O2** signs a 10-year deal for solar energy, aiming for Net Zero by 2040.
EE Expands 5G+ Network - **EE** utilizes world-first RAN coordination technology to enhance its 5G+ network capabilities.
AI-Driven Billing Agility - **Sarathi Softech**'s EarnBill platform offers flexible billing solutions for telecom operators facing market complexities.
